title: Which die number appears most in thirty rolls?
description: A die is rolled thirty times and each result is recorded with tally marks in a frequency table. The numbers that appear the least, the most and an equal number of times are read from the tallies, and the total is checked against thirty.
teaching_notes: One idea: record every roll with a tally mark, count the tallies for each number, and compare the counts. Each child gets different rolls, so the video uses one sample set of rolls. Watch for students who forget to check that the counts add up to thirty.

video_script.why: The child records thirty rolls of a die in a frequency table with tally marks and reads the least, the most and the equal counts.
video_script.substitution: The results of thirty rolls of a die are recorded in a table with tally marks.
video_script.anchor: a die rolled thirty times with each result recorded in a table with tally marks
video_script.payoff_line: Compare the tallies, the shortest shows the least and the longest shows the most

final_answer.spoken: it depends on your own rolls: compare the tallies, the shortest shows the least and the longest shows the most

maths_rules: a die has 6 faces, numbered 1 to 6, so the table has 6 rows
the 30 rolls give 30 tally marks in all
sample rolls: 1 appeared 4 times, 2 appeared 6 times, 3 appeared 5 times, 4 appeared 7 times, 5 appeared 3 times, 6 appeared 5 times
in the sample, the least is 3 times (number 5), the most is 7 times (number 4), and 3 and 6 appeared an equal 5 times
video_script.design: The child's own thirty rolls cannot be known, so one sample set of rolls is used to show the method. Each child repeats the same steps with their own rolls.
open_questions: The answer depends on each child's own rolls. The sample counts 4, 6, 5, 7, 3 and 5 are invented to show the method and are not from the book.
